en.heading: Turn a PDF into an H5P Course Presentation
en.web_subtitle: Each page is kept as a faithful slide background in a Course Presentation. The conversion runs in your browser: the PDF never leaves your computer.
en.subtitle: Each page is kept as a faithful slide background in a Course Presentation, ready to import and edit in Moodle.
en.note_text: To ensure version compatibility, export an empty Course Presentation from your Moodle site and use it as the template.
